nodes.label: PUBLIC_JWK (ECDSA P-256 public key)
nodes.rationale: Lets the door verify each QR was issued by Skyline offline, without internet.

nodes.label: sky_admin_pin (localStorage/sessionStorage)
nodes.rationale: PIN kept in localStorage only when 'remember' is checked, otherwise sessionStorage; cleared on 401.

nodes.label: SKY1 signed ticket QR format (SKY1.token.type.sig)
nodes.rationale: Tickets carry an ECDSA signature so authenticity is checkable offline; type 1 = 1-day, type 2 = 2-day access.

nodes.label: confirmacion check()
nodes.rationale: Polls get-tickets every 3s up to 3 min; network errors retry at 6s without losing the page.

nodes.label: confirmacion renderTicket()
nodes.rationale: Client-side 1080x1350 canvas PNG ticket, same design as the admin panel.

nodes.label: localStorage key skyline_pixel_purchase_<order_id>
nodes.rationale: Dedupe guard so the Purchase pixel event fires once per order.

nodes.label: localStorage key sky_orders
nodes.rationale: Remembers up to 10 orders on this device so buyer can return to tickets/payment status after reload.

nodes.label: Terms §3 Código QR y validación de boletas
nodes.norm_label: terms §3 codigo qr y validacion de boletas
nodes.rationale: QR unique per ticket; if presented twice only the first valid scan is admitted.

nodes.label: Event night boundary rule (noon-to-noon Bogota time)
nodes.norm_label: event night boundary rule (noon-to-noon bogota time)
nodes.rationale: A night spans 12:00 to 11:59 next day (UTC-5) so someone entering at 1am on the 31st counts for the night of the 30th.

nodes.label: Manual search admission (name/document)
nodes.rationale: Fallback when QR cannot be read.

nodes.label: Offline-first admission with server claim
nodes.rationale: With signal, server is asked (claim) since it knows if another scanner used the ticket; if no response within CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS (2.5s), decide locally and upload later.

nodes.label: Test mode (outside event nights)
nodes.rationale: Outside configured event nights, scans are stored separately in sky_test_checkins and never uploaded, so test reads never block a real ticket.

nodes.label: Pay button click handler (create order + open Bold)
nodes.norm_label: pay button click handler (create order + open bold)
nodes.rationale: One order per payment attempt; Bold checkout opened with server-provided integrity signature.

nodes.label: Bold payment gateway (BoldCheckout)
nodes.rationale: Official custom integration: order is created only on pay click to avoid duplicate orders while the user types.

nodes.label: Edge Function create-order
nodes.rationale: Single endpoint serves both price/promo lookup (action:'prices') and order creation; server is source of truth for prices and promoter discounts so client only displays them.

nodes.label: localStorage key sky_buy_draft
nodes.rationale: Purchase form draft survives reload; drafts older than 7 days ignored; cleared when order is paid.

nodes.label: Promoter discount code
nodes.rationale: Codes without a random -XXX suffix trigger a confirm before enabling discount because guessable codes would let anyone pay promoter price.

nodes.label: Incremental sync via since/server_time cursor
nodes.rationale: Server timestamp stored as sky_since to download only changes; AUTO_SYNC_MS=15s because multiple scanners are active.
